name: Sports
overview: Scripture uses the imagery of struggle and striving, as seen in Jacob's wrestling until dawn, to illustrate the Christian life’s challenges and perseverance. True glory is found not in self-exaltation or pride, but in humility before God, who exalts the humble and opposes the proud. Believers are called to press toward the spiritual goal—the high calling in Christ—valuing strength rightly and rejecting the pursuit of personal glory. These truths guide a Christ-centered approach to sports, emphasizing discipline, humility, and the pursuit of God's purpose above earthly acclaim.
